result.title: AgroGround: Multi-Granularity Grounded Recognition in Agriculture
result.summary: Agricultural visual models are typically evaluated for either recognition or localization, but reliable diagnosis requires identifying what is present and localizing the evidence. Agricultural visual question answering (VQA) datasets carry rich semantic labels but rarely link them to image regions, and adding such annotations by hand is costly at scale. We introduce AgroGround, a large-scale dataset for grounded agricultural recognition: identifying plant diseases and other agricultural targets and localizing their image regions. An automated pipeline converts the labels of eight agricultural VQA datasets into annotations for disease lesions and whole objects, producing 794,850 instruction examples. Healthy images provide negative supervision for disease queries, teaching the model to return empty predictions. We fine-tune a shared vision-language model on known-target grounding instructions combined with instructions requiring both recognition and localization. We evaluate predicted identities, regions, joint correctness, and healthy-image abstention on 1,480 human-verified images disjoint from all training data. Grounding-only fine-tuning reduces recognition accuracy from 51.8\% to 29.1\%, while adding recognition-and-localization instructions raises it to 72.6\%. With images and annotations held fixed, combining the two formats raises joint accuracy from 19.2\% to 43.3\% at comparable grounding. Healthy negatives raise abstention on healthy images to 95.0\%, and reinforcement learning improves lesion-level grounding. The resulting 2B model exceeds its annotation teacher in grounding F1 on our benchmark and on the external PlantSeg test set. AgroGround establishes a benchmark for grounded agricultural recognition, measuring joint correctness of identity and localization along with abstention on healthy images. The code is available at https://github.com/AB-Abdulla/AgroGround.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作构建 AgroGround 农业 grounded 识别数据集，用自动流水线把八个农业 VQA 数据集的标签转成病灶与整体目标的区域标注，并微调共享 VLM 以同时做识别与定位，评测身份、区域、联合正确性及健康图像弃答。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线的联系在于「识别+定位联合指令」与健康负样本的弃答监督：后者近似为「何时停止/拒绝输出」的信号，其消融（仅定位反而降低识别）可能为 LVR 中证据使用与监督格式配比提供可核查线索；但任务是农业 VQA，未涉及 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行判断。
